+import unittest
+from cachelib.core import TTLCache
+
+class FakeClock:
+    def __init__(self, start=0):
+        self.now = start
+    def __call__(self):
+        return self.now
+    def advance(self, delta):
+        self.now += delta
+
+class TTLCacheTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_capacity_zero_raises(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            TTLCache(0)
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            TTLCache(-1)
+
+    def test_basic_put_get(self):
+        c = TTLCache(2)
+        c.put('a', 1)
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('a'), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(len(c), 1)
+
+    def test_none_false_zero_values(self):
+        c = TTLCache(3)
+        c.put('n', None)
+        c.put('f', False)
+        c.put('z', 0)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('n'))
+        self.assertFalse(c.get('f'))
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('z'), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(len(c), 3)
+
+    def test_get_default(self):
+        c = TTLCache(2)
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('missing', 'x'), 'x')
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('missing'))
+
+    def test_lru_eviction(self):
+        c = TTLCache(2)
+        c.put('a', 1)
+        c.put('b', 2)
+        c.get('a')
+        c.put('c', 3)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('b'))
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('a'), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('c'), 3)
+
+    def test_put_promotes_mru(self):
+        c = TTLCache(2)
+        c.put('a', 1)
+        c.put('b', 2)
+        c.put('a', 10)
+        c.put('c', 3)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('b'))
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('a'), 10)
+
+    def test_ttl_expiry(self):
+        clock = FakeClock()
+        c = TTLCache(2, clock=clock)
+        c.put('a', 1, ttl=10)
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('a'), 1)
+        clock.advance(9)
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('a'), 1)
+        clock.advance(2)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('a'))
+        self.assertEqual(len(c), 0)
+
+    def test_ttl_none_never_expires(self):
+        clock = FakeClock()
+        c = TTLCache(2, clock=clock)
+        c.put('a', 1, ttl=None)
+        clock.advance(1000)
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('a'), 1)
+
+    def test_ttl_zero_removes(self):
+        c = TTLCache(2)
+        c.put('a', 1)
+        c.put('a', 2, ttl=0)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('a'))
+        self.assertEqual(len(c), 0)
+
+    def test_ttl_negative_removes(self):
+        c = TTLCache(2)
+        c.put('a', 1)
+        c.put('a', 2, ttl=-5)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('a'))
+
+    def test_expiry_before_eviction(self):
+        clock = FakeClock()
+        c = TTLCache(2, clock=clock)
+        c.put('a', 1, ttl=5)
+        c.put('b', 2)
+        clock.advance(6)
+        c.put('c', 3)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('a'))
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('b'), 2)
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('c'), 3)
+        self.assertEqual(len(c), 2)
+
+    def test_get_promotes_mru(self):
+        c = TTLCache(2)
+        c.put('a', 1)
+        c.put('b', 2)
+        c.get('a')
+        c.put('c', 3)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('b'))
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('a'), 1)
+
+    def test_get_miss_no_promote(self):
+        c = TTLCache(2)
+        c.put('a', 1)
+        c.put('b', 2)
+        c.get('missing')
+        c.put('c', 3)
+        self.assertIsNone(c.get('a'))
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('b'), 2)
+        self.assertEqual(c.get('c'), 3)
+
+    def test_len_counts_live_only(self):
+        clock = FakeClock()
+        c = TTLCache(3, clock=clock)
+        c.put('a', 1, ttl=5)
+        c.put('b', 2, ttl=5)
+        c.put('c', 3)
+        self.assertEqual(len(c), 3)
+        clock.advance(6)
+        self.assertEqual(len(c), 1)
+
+    def test_put_resets_ttl(self):
+        clock = FakeClock()

+        clock.advance(5)
